title: Kanban delivery
description: Workflow policies, work in progress and flow metrics for a team managing continuous demand.

rules.instruction: Agree where a work item starts and finishes, which policies govern movement and how the team will control work in progress.
rules.verification: Select an item in each state and ask its owner to show why the item entered that state and which capacity policy applies.

rules.instruction: When active work reaches its limit, help finish or unblock an item before pulling another. Record any agreed exception with its cause.
rules.verification: Compare actual item counts with the team's limits and check how any exceptions were resolved.

rules.instruction: Use completed items to estimate a service level expectation and inspect active items whose age approaches it. Track cycle time, work in progress, throughput and work item age.
rules.verification: Recompute the metrics from a sample of movement records and confirm what the team changed in response to an aging or blocked item.
